question: What is the meaning of thermal conductivity in relation to building physics?
description: Thermal conductivity refers to the ability of a material to conduct heat. In relation to building physics, it is an important property that affects the energy and thermal performance of a building. High thermal conductivity materials can transfer heat quickly, while low thermal conductivity materials can slow down heat transfer. This property is crucial for designing energy-efficient buildings and managing indoor air quality.
